canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Delyn Nethai: 18-year-old woman, 150 cm (very-short), healthy slight, narrow, long-limbed construction with low mass, skin value band-2-light. Face: long narrow face; small bright eyes and fine straight brows; broad low bridge, full lips; no added facial mark. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: blonde-gold, long-loose, deliberate accent: strong split-length construction. Wardrobe: asymmetric-patchwork, specifically intentional patchwork layers with an uneven hem, visible repairs, and practical trousers; rolled sleeves and one architectural lapel; bounded palette moss-ivory. Visible personal details: an extensive patchwork of ordinary ink marks across the arms and upper back; a shaped cloth clasp. Make the garment hem and outer silhouette the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: visible mending treated as prideful craft. Color treatment: lets faded and repaired areas vary the palette. Pose cue: stance is broad and still, with one palm turned slightly upward. Include a blunt carpenter's chalk only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
